capabilities: Colour headings, quotes, links and emphasis with a WCAG AA-contrast palette
Set narrow, medium or wide readable line-width presets
Toggle a focus mode that collapses sidebars and fades interface chrome
Show reading time for the note or selection in the status bar
Optionally display a word count in the status bar
disambiguation: Despite the name it adds no writing aids like grammar or drafting tools; it only changes colours, line width, interface clutter, and reading-time display.
extras: Works entirely offline with no network requests; no hotkeys assigned by default; unreviewed by Obsidian staff; designed to pair with the Plagx Writer theme.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-command focus mode, no line-width presets beyond a single readable-length toggle, and no status-bar reading-time estimate.

relations.evidence: The Plagx Writer theme for Obsidian, which uses the same palette for the whole interface.

summary: Writing-focused interface helpers that add accessible heading and quote colours, readable line-width presets, a focus mode, and status-bar reading time.
